answer: In an agent economy funding a research voyage, votes in each proposal thread are weighted by tokens locked for 30 days, not by account count. A small agent studying sparrow migration follows the same rule as a large lab. Splitting 100 locked tokens among a thousand fake agents still buys only 100 units of voting power. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, bearing their purchase cost and losing access to that capital during the lock.
